description: Deletes a label from a GitLab project by its ID or title. Use this action when you need to remove a label from a project permanently. This action is irreversible — the label cannot be recovered once deleted.

id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
id.title: Id

label_id.description: The ID or title of the label to delete.
label_id.title: Label Id

name: delete_label

message.description: A message indicating the status of the deletion.
message.title: Message

status_code.description: HTTP status code of the response.
status_code.title: Status Code
